rationale: iter-10 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: ONE knob pretrain_epochs 6->9 on the iter-4 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, val_n16, grad_clip1.0, seed42 -> 0.9596). val_n reset 24->16 so pretrain_epochs is the ONLY change vs the iter-4 peak (apples-to-apples; iter-9 val_n24=0.9609 was a cleaner read of the same recon, not a new lever). NOT-yet-tried axis = an INTERMEDIATE warm-start INIT epoch count. The pretrain_epochs trend is NON-MONOTONE: ep3->6 LIFTED 0.9593->0.9596 (iter-4, positive), ep6->12 REGRESSED to 0.9585 (iter-5). The peak therefore sits between ep6 and ep12 and ep9 (the midpoint) is genuinely UNTESTED -- it is the remaining live warm-start-init probe. Forbidden/known-dead axes AVOIDED: n_iter HURTS (iter-2 n_iter600 0.9553->0.9407, per-scan U-Net has no early-stop -> overfit); warm_start is LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE (kept True, NEVER off); unet_c flat (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); seed noise-stable (iter-7 0.9588); grad_clip flat (iter-8 0.9597). Failure mode at 0.9609: per-image U-Net N2I on dense-view 128-angle breast is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED -- the half-angle view-split discards information the full-view 128-view LD-FBP keeps, so each per-scan GT-free fit caps BELOW the LD-FBP baseline (hr=0); a substrate ceiling, not an optimization/capacity one. Hypothesis: ep9 lands WITHIN NOISE of 0.9596 (between the ep6 peak 0.9596 and the ep12 regression 0.9585), confirming the warm-start-init lever is saturated at the ep6 peak and the ~0.96 breast per-image U-Net N2I ceiling is FBP-bounded, not a finer-init artefact -- toward the iter-20 ceiling-documentation mandate. A material lift would mean the ep6->12 regression overshot a true ep9 optimum (a finer-init lever after all); a material drop would mean init quality is fragile past ep6. Wall: iter-5 (ep12, val_n16) ran 592s; ep9 at val_n16 is fewer pretrain steps -> est ~530-560s, well under the 900s/15-min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
